description: This Java interface defines a factory for creating MQTT clients and client builders, specifically tailored for HiveMQ MQTT clients used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for instantiating clients with specific connection parameters, reconnect options, and event listeners.

classes.name: HiveMqttClientFactory
classes.description: A generic factory interface for creating HiveMQ MQTT clients and builders with customizable connection and listener parameters.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a new MQTT client with specified connection parameters, optional reconnect capability, and optional event listeners.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MQTT client builder configured based on the given connection and identifier, with optional reconnect capability and event listeners.

methods.name: default newClient
methods.description: Default method that creates an MQTT client without specified event listeners, delegating to the main 'newClient' method.
